hypotheses.Q0_native_projected_attention_recomposes: The explicit native QK/value contraction reproduces the Layer-0 gate and finite effect at fidelity at least 0.9999 everywhere.
hypotheses.Q1_pure_rules_ignore_irrelevant_digit_id: Both mean and cyclic replacement of rule-irrelevant digit keys and values retain at least 0.85 held-out-template fidelity in every pure run.
hypotheses.Q2_mixed_selected_needs_irrelevant_digit: For every pair, pure irrelevant-mean-both fidelity exceeds mixed-selected fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.Q3_mixed_selected_needs_irrelevant_digit: For every pair, pure irrelevant-roll-both fidelity exceeds mixed-selected fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.Q4_value_identity_dominates_key_identity: For every mixed selected run, erasing irrelevant value identity loses at least 0.10 more fidelity than erasing irrelevant key identity for both mean and cyclic controls.
hypotheses.Q5_key_identity_is_also_material: Erasing only irrelevant key identity leaves below 0.95 held-out-template fidelity in every mixed selected run for either the mean or cyclic control.
hypotheses.Q6_mixed_unselected_routes_are_globally_: For every pair, pure irrelevant-mean-both fidelity exceeds mixed-unselected fidelity by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.Q7_mean_and_roll_controls_agree: For every run/status, irrelevant mean-both and roll-both fidelities differ by at most 0.15 on the held-out template.
hypotheses.Q8_identity_route_conclusion_transfers_t: Irrelevant-mean-both fidelity differs by at most 0.10 between trained and held-out templates in every run/status.
hypotheses.Q9_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
